name: Alter hreflang
description: Alters the hreflang attribute emitted for each page based on the current site language, letting you override the langcode used in alternate-language <link> tags.
project_description:
Alter hreflang

---------------

This will help to alter the hreflang attribute based on the languages of the site. Using this we can set the custom language format (e.g., es-es, en-us).

or

 It will perfectly work with multilingual sites as well apart from a single language site.

 Installation

------------

1) Download the module and place it inside the modules/contrib directory or install using the composer "composer require 'drupal/alter_hreflang:^1.0'.

 2) Enable the Alter hreflang module from /admin/modules URL.

 3) Configuration URL /admin/config/regional/alter-hreflang
